answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 1427 Country: India Title: My question is can we wear tie for the functions, second is can we use perfume which is used in the scents as when the nozzle is pressed it gives out spray? Question: My question is can we wear tie for the functions, second is can we use perfume which is used in the scents as when the nozzle is pressed it gives out spray? Answer ID: 1427 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 578/566=N) (1) Tie was basically introduced by non-Muslims; therefore a Muslim should avoid using it until there is some compelling necessity. (2) The alcohol is used to intensify the perfume and scents. If you are sure that alcohol used in perfume was prepared from grape and date then it will not be allowed to use the perfume. And, if the alcohol is not prepared by the two agents then such perfumes are allowable to use, rather it is better to keep off. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
